name: Scapegoat Tattoo

reviews.text: I was tattooed by a guest artist, Ike Greca. Absolutely love his work. The shop itself was beautifully decorated and very clean. The fellow artists and reception were kind. The shop is hidden behind a huge shrub but is easy to find, parking is ample in the evening.
reviews.author: Alex Moreno

reviews.text: Getting tattooed by John was a solid experience. He’s a really nice guy and does high quality work. 10/10 would get tattooed by him again.
reviews.author: Marc Goldsticker

reviews.text: Came in as a walk in and was really well taken care of. Wanted some lines from a poem that is really impactful to me, and they nailed my vision 100%, and it’s healing fantastically.
reviews.author: Dustin Edgar

reviews.text: Brian is a true artist, he did a whole sleeve for me and couldn't love a tattoo more!
reviews.author: Mary Galvin

reviews.text: I saw Virginia aka @niemo_tattoo and I cannot express how happy I am I found her. She has such a sweet and calming personality. She does INCREDIBLE fine line too. I got a thin delicate small rose on my arm, as well as a butterfly and they turned out perfect!! I honestly wish I had found her sooner!! I recommend her to ALL of my friends now. Can’t wait to see her again for the rest of my tatts! 12/10 recommend. She’s the best!!
reviews.author: Sasha Hindrum
